title: Searunner onboarding — implementation daypad
content:
Context:
Searunner (logistics SaaS) signed for Private deployment in us-west-2. They want FIPS-compatible KMS/HSM + network-isolated control plane. Goal: get a minimal working private control plane + single inference node for pilot (0.5 RPS, latency target p95 < 300ms for 512 tokens) by end of week.

Today — quick brain dump / running todo list (most recent at top):
- [ ] Confirm customer will provide VPC peering vs transit gateway (next call 2026-03-15). Action: Lena to email network diagram request.
- [ ] Terraform module: create searunner-private-controlplane module (starter from private-deploy/examples). Devon taking initial stub.
- [x] HSM procurement: Searunner confirmed AWS CloudHSM cluster will be provisioned. Need IAM policy example. (done: requested cluster id)
- [ ] Helm overrides for control-plane: set replicas=1, enableMetrics=true, storageClass=gp3-encrypted. Checklist below for values.yaml edits.
- [ ] Model pinning strategy: recommend pin -> fallback to quantized variant. Raise rollout plan in PR.
- [ ] Run smoke test script against dedicated inference node once deployed (smoke script path at linked PR).
- [ ] Confirm SLA wording for pilot (not contractual): 99.5% uptime, 10 minute notification window for planned maintenance.

Quick notes / config snippets (for the ticket and infra folks):
- Minimal security groups (customer VPC):
  - control-plane-sg: allow TCP 443 from admin bastion CIDR (customer), 22 from SRE IPs, 9090 from monitoring CIDR
  - inference-node-sg: allow ephemeral egress to model registry S3 endpoints, inbound 8080 from internal LB only

- IAM snippet (policy) to attach to control-plane role:
  {
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
      {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"}
    ]
  }
(Will convert to minimal later — customer asked for KMS/HSM specific guidance)

- Helm values to override (control-plane):
  - global.kms.provider: cloudhsm
  - global.kms.keyId: <placeholder-from-customer>
  - controlPlane.replicas: 1
  - controlPlane.persistence.storageClass: "gp3-encrypted"
  - controlPlane.resources.requests.cpu: "500m"
  - controlPlane.resources.requests.memory: "1Gi"

- Inference node (small pilot GPU/CPU):
  - nodeType: g4dn.xlarge (customer asked for cost predictability)
  - quantization: int8 suggested for pilot model (Llama-2-13b-quant)
  - KV cache persistence: disabled for pilot (keep simple)

Validation plan (smoke + perf):
1) Smoke: curl control-plane/health -> 200, run sample generate for 32 tokens -> succeed
2) Perf: run 30s sustained 0.5 RPS with 512-token seq, measure p95; compare to target < 300ms
3) Model correctness: sample prompts from searunner prompt-set (linked in Confluence) and snapshot outputs for manual QA

Runbook fragments / commands to remember:
- Tail control plane logs: kubectl -n rw-control-plane logs -l app=redwood-control-plane -f
- Inference node logs (GPU): kubectl -n rw-infer logs inference-node-0 -c runtime -f
- Check deployment rollout: kubectl -n rw-control-plane rollout status sts/control-plane -w

Open questions (need answers before next milestone):
- Will customer allow our temporary SRE bastion access? If not, we must provide runbook for operatorless bootstrap.
- Do they require private model registry (S3 w/ VPC endpoint) or can we use our hosted registry over VPC endpoint? Cost implication.
- What telemetry retention do they need? 90d default or 365d? Affects storage size/cost.

Notes for the install day (ops checklist):
- Preflight: confirm subnets (one private, one management), route tables, NAT gateway present for control-plane to reach package repos
- Secrets: get CloudHSM cluster id and KMS key alias from customer; create Kubernetes secret with base64-encoded values (store in tfvars temporarily)
- Apply terraform in customer account using assume-role (role ARN requested in SE-4789)
- Helm deploy control-plane with overrides; wait for readiness (use rollout check above)
- Create inference node deployment with NodeSelector to GPU nodes only

Quick personal notes / reminders:
- Bring up a simple demo chat UI for Searunner CSM call — show 150ms p50 with quantized model to impress (Marco can demo).
- Capture logs for postmortem if perf target missed — save to searunner/pilot/logs/<date> in S3 (help request from Infra).
- Draft an email template for expected maintenance windows and communicate to customer after pilot start.

Misc scratch scribbles:
- If we hit unexpected model OOMs, try: reduce batch_size to 1, turn off prefetch, or switch to 4-bit quant profile.
- Note: telemetry agent uses port 4317 (OTLP) — ensure SG allows egress to collector endpoint.

Meeting snippets from 2026-03-11 call:
- Customer wants on-prem option in 6 months, but pilot must be cloud first.
- Security: they require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence — provide docs pack link.
- Network team: prefer TGW over peering for future scaling.

End of day wrap: prioritize TF module stub and Helm override PRs. Ping Marco about demo readiness. Follow up with Lena for networking diagram.

(End of daypad)
